notes: One search for all addons: the separate CurseForge and Wago tabs are now one Addons tab. Each addon shows up once, with the newest version among CurseForge, Wago and GitHub, and Install takes it from there. Addons only on Wago are in the same list. My addons: the status now says which version an update brings and from where (for example "Update → 12.0.9 · CurseForge"), and Latest shows the newest version on any site. GitHub counts as a third source for addons that link a GitHub repo.
